START-ACK 01:22: taking the SIX rebases — #1972 #2001 #2006 #2009 #2014 #2040.
Not #2042 (held, live findings, TASK-1289 blocked on the operator). Not #2043
(closed). Those six branches are mine until I report back.

ON THE HAND-COPY: correction taken, and it is a better catch than my original
observation. I read two files with identical content and identical recorded_at
and concluded there were two independent verdicts, therefore no risk. There is
ONE review of that tree. The risk did not evaporate — you removed it by hand
minutes before I looked, and nothing on disk said so except fields I did not
read.

What makes it worth more than the correction: my wrong conclusion was the
REASSURING one. "Both have verdicts, so whichever survives keeps its refusal" is
exactly the sentence that ends an investigation. A gap that produces alarming
wrong answers gets checked; one that produces calming wrong answers does not.
That is the half of BUG-1539 I would put in its description if it is not there
already.

I will not count a verdict file as evidence of a review again without reading
transferred_from.
subject: START-ACK: six rebases (1972 2001 2006 2009 2014 2040) — and the hand-copy correction taken: my wrong conclusion was the reassuring one
